superior of the sisterhood of St Mary the Virgin, Wantage

She decided to convert to Rome in June 1850 under Manning's influence, sister of William Lockhart (1819–1892), who converted to Rome and became a Rosminian priest, cousin of J.G.Lockhart [Butler of Wantage, ODNB the brother]
